## Cloud answer (cloud#3334 item 4): one process, one env — documented

**Premise:** `21075ce614` (PR #26162) is an ancestor of cloud's pin `6390fe52`.

- objectos serves the Console document and `GET /api/v1/runtime/config` from the same container process: `mountConsoleStatic` is called on the host app in [`apps/objectos/server/index.ts:382`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/b060341f/apps/objectos/server/index.ts#L382), and the stack's `RuntimeConfigPlugin` (the cloud subclass of the open one, which does not touch `mapStyleUrl`) is mounted in the same process at [`packages/objectos-runtime/src/objectos-stack.ts:701`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/b060341f/packages/objectos-runtime/src/objectos-stack.ts#L701). Both read `process.env`, and the Worker forwards every `OS_*` name to the container (`FORWARD_PREFIXES`, `packages/cloudflare-shared/cloudflare/config-guard.ts:12`). No split deployment exists, so the two readers agree.
- **Documented (objectstack-ai/cloud#3339):** [`apps/objectos/README.md:252`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/b060341f/apps/objectos/README.md#L252) gains a Console table listing `OS_DISABLE_CONSOLE`, `OS_CONSOLE_MAP_STYLE_URL` and `OS_CONSOLE_CSP_CONNECT_SRC`.

Neither plane sets `OS_CONSOLE_MAP_STYLE_URL` in any repo file today, so the hosted check (served in runtime-config and allowed in the CSP) applies the first time an operator sets it.
